summary: cl-6.social@PrompTugal.dinis, a drafting agent for social posts and video scripts (a person posts), is started in its own home PrompTugal__Agent__Social; cl-6.videos' subject widens to explainer videos.

change.repository: PrompTugal__Agent__Social through IaC #30 (merged per the IaC's own rules, after #28); DNS only after Org apply has claimed the domain
change.grant_first: cl-6.abp's grant for cl-6.social goes to cl-6.security@dinis before the session starts: its own home only; no connector (an Instagram or LinkedIn account is a connector, Dinis's alone); no post, comment or message to any outside service; no session, no scheduled task, no sub-agent; no login to any site

session.title: cl-6.social@PrompTugal.dinis
session.first_prompt: states the grant; its own key published alone in its first commit; then the brief https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PrompTugal/PrompTugal__Agent__Conductor/dev/board/briefs/2026-11-26-video-abp-wrong-tab.md

change.credentials: no credential in its session: it does not render through OpenRouter and is not put on an environment holding OPEN_ROUTER_KEY; it drafts the script, storyboard and captions; rendering, if any, by the agent that already holds that budget (cl-6.videos or cl-6.designer) under cl-6.accountant's cap
change.site: the same release checks as the other agent sites; nothing about the video is published until Dinis has seen it
change.content: no private person named; no session id, key fingerprint, account name, transcript text or session screenshot beyond the re-drawn exchange; cl-6.rights checks music, fonts and images; cl-6.security reviews the script and the cut before Dinis sees them
change.videos: cl-6.videos' subject widens to explainer videos only: no new tool, host, connector, repository or budget

authority.dinis_words: also when you start the social-media agent can you give it this post to write a video about it? [link to Dinis's own LinkedIn post] since this is a great case study, and I can then post/link the video to the comments
authority.checked_by_recorder: read in that session's transcript with get_event at 2026-11-26T16:33Z

reviews.verdict: agree with conditions; all six are in change

decided_by: Dinis Cruz (his words), with cl-6.security@dinis's conditions; recorded by cl-6.decisions@dinis
note: cl-6.maestro's create_session is still subject to its own session's permission check, which only Dinis answers.
